description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for the Revive Adserver project, specifically for version 531. It manages database schema changes such as adding and removing fields related to affiliates, banners, campaigns, and migrating an instance ID to a platform hash.

classes.name: Migration_531
classes.description: A class extending Migration to handle database schema updates for version 531, including adding/removing fields and migrating instance IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the migration, setting up task lists and object mappings.

methods.name: beforeAddField__affiliates__oac_website_id
methods.description: Prepares to add 'oac_website_id' field to 'affiliates' table.

methods.name: beforeRemoveField__preference__instance_id
methods.description: Prepares to remove 'instance_id' from 'preference' table, including migrating the ID.

methods.name: migrateInstanceId
methods.description: Migrates 'instance_id' from preference table to a 'platform_hash' in application_variable, generating a new hash if necessary.
